description: Find all references to a symbol. Returns text like grep's, one `file:line: [use] code` per reference, so the line itself says whether it is a call, a type, a literal, a write or a read

bySymbol.description: With detail lines: put each reference under the definition it sits in

detail.description: lines: text like grep's, `file:line: [use] code` per reference, where use is def, call, literal, write, type or read; imports are counted, not listed. files: JSON, line numbers grouped per file. full: JSON, one entry per reference with columns and reference kind

limit.description: Maximum number of references to return

scope.description: Path prefix or module ID to limit search scope (e.g., 'src/services/', 'internal/query')

name: findReferences
